comparison.objective: Hot-swap a failed server PSU while leaving the live PSU undisturbed; candidate screens finishing media.
comparison.physical_skill: PSU service tests latch squeezing, square extraction, guided high-force connector insertion, and neighboring-component avoidance, not controlled sifting.
comparison.success_condition: Failed PSU removed, spare fully seated and latched for 1 s, with >5 mm live-PSU motion zeroing the run; candidate requires separation, retention, reseating, clearance, and 3 s dwell.
comparison.reason: Although both protect retained items, adjacent-module replacement is not selective many-body separation.
